entries.en: to shout at him; to cry out
entries.notes: L 栏首词残缺（Darle boz），仅 darle grio（喊叫）可辨；H 整濁伊与 R 栏做不合，zh 无从立义，en 暂依 L 可辨残文。

entries.en: to strike hard; to deal a heavy blow (with a stick)
entries.notes: H 擬与 L gran porrazo（猛击）义不合，M tīm、R chīm 亦不相证，语义无法定夺，暂依 L 立义。

entries.en: to beat the breast with the fist; to pound
entries.notes: H 捱与 M/R 对音（捶）不合，据 L 以拳捶胸义与 M/R 立义。

entries.en: to strike the breast; to beat the chest
to strike one's breast with the open hand; to slap the chest
entries.notes: H 有〔疑:捨/撻〕之辨，撻与对音 tā 相合，据 L 张掌拍胸义立义。

entries.en: to give alms; to relieve, succour (the poor)
to relieve with money or food; to give relief, alms
to give alms; to bestow in charity
to butt with the head (like a ram); to jostle, push
entries.notes: H 擠与 L 如羊以头抵触义不合，M quiā guiū、R ỷ 难解，语义无法定夺，暂依 L 立义。

entries.en: to give a ration; to serve out an allowance of food
entries.notes: M 栏 [残]；H 閔与 R cūan 难与 L 相证（或 dar ración 配给口粮，或 dar razón 传话），zh 无从定夺，en 暂依 L。

entries.zh: 万般应承；对客人事事应允、百般款待
entries.en: to oblige/entertain the guest in every way; to make gifts to the guest
entries.notes: H/R 万般应承与 L dar regalos（17 世纪亦可指殷勤款待）字面所指有别，两义并存立义。

entries.en: to part with reluctantly; to give up, relinquish
entries.notes: R 栏对音与 H 割捨、M cuà sià 不合，据 H/M/L 立义。

entries.en: to give money to the invited guests; share-out of the feast in money
entries.notes: 拆席确义难确指（或即以钱折席散与宾客），据 L 与 M/R 立义；R 第二音 dȳ 与 M sēg 不合。

entries.en: to give money to the invited guests
entries.notes: 拆乾之乾难解，据 L dar dinero a los convidados 与 M/R 立义。

entries.en: to hit the mark in throwing; to hit the target
entries.notes: M/R 栏 T99 污损；L 掷中目标与 H 做出头对应存疑，分栏立义。

entries.en: to forward, pass on (a letter or thing) to another
entries.notes: L 栏残缺且含缩写 p̃ g̃，据 H/R 转寄立义。

entries.en: to beat/mark the time in music; to keep the beat
entries.notes: M 栏 [残] 且 T99（首音难辨），据 L 音乐节拍义与 H 拍位立义。

entries.en: to give against/upon a written token or pledge
entries.notes: L 栏残缺（Dar a lo p̃ g̃ Sta cuer de），缩写展开依赖推断，据 H/R 憑表記立义。

entries.en: to give thanks; to return thanks

entries.zh: 持刀向前抵拒；把（刀）抵在面前
entries.en: to put forth a knife before (someone); to brandish a knife at
entries.notes: L 句末残断（p̃ que se sa），H 把盡难解且 M choâ 与 R chīn 不合，语义无法定夺，据 L 可辨部分立义。

entries.en: to give thanks; to thank
to return thanks; to requite kindness with thanks
